stories.title: Monitor Spacecraft Health and Status
stories.description: As a mission control operator, I want to monitor the spacecraft's health and status continuously, so that any anomalies can be detected and addressed promptly.

acceptance_criteria.description: System displays real-time telemetry data from spacecraft.
Alerts are generated for critical system failures or threshold breaches.

edge_cases: Telemetry data loss or corruption is detected and handled.
False positive alerts are minimized through filtering.
technical_notes: Implement dashboard with customizable views.
Use redundancy in telemetry channels for reliability.

stories.title: Collect Scientific Data on Mars Surface
stories.description: As a scientist, I want to collect and transmit scientific data from Mars surface, so that we can analyze Mars environment and geology.

acceptance_criteria.description: Scientific instruments collect data as per mission plan.
Data is transmitted to Earth with integrity and within expected timeframes.
System alerts if instruments malfunction or data transmission fails.

edge_cases: Instruments handle power fluctuations or environmental hazards.
Data retransmission occurs if communication is interrupted.
technical_notes: Implement data compression and error correction for transmission.
Schedule instrument operation to optimize power usage.

stories.title: Prepare Launch Operations
stories.description: As a launch coordinator, I want to prepare all launch operations including scheduling, vehicle integration, and safety checks, so that the spacecraft can be launched on time and safely.

acceptance_criteria.description: Launch schedule is created and approved.
Spacecraft is integrated with launch vehicle and passes all pre-launch tests.
Safety protocols are documented and emergency procedures are in place.

edge_cases: Launch delays due to weather or technical issues are accounted for.
Contingency plans for launch abort scenarios are defined.
technical_notes: Coordinate with ground control and range safety teams.
Implement checklist automation for pre-launch procedures.

stories.title: Develop Interplanetary Navigation System
stories.description: As a navigation engineer, I want to develop a navigation system that can guide the spacecraft from Earth to Mars accurately, so that the mission trajectory is maintained and arrival at Mars is successful.

acceptance_criteria.description: Navigation system calculates trajectory and updates course corrections.
System can handle communication delays and autonomous adjustments.
Navigation data is logged and available for mission control monitoring.

edge_cases: System handles sensor failures or data loss gracefully.
Navigation recalculations occur if unexpected trajectory deviations happen.
technical_notes: Use onboard sensors and ground-based tracking data.
Implement fault-tolerant algorithms for autonomous navigation.

stories.title: Execute Mars Landing Sequence
stories.description: As a mission operator, I want to execute the Mars landing sequence safely and accurately, so that the spacecraft can land on Mars surface without damage.

acceptance_criteria.description: Landing sequence includes entry, descent, and touchdown phases.
System monitors landing parameters and triggers abort if unsafe conditions detected.
Landing site is confirmed and communication with spacecraft is maintained.

edge_cases: Landing system handles unexpected atmospheric conditions.
Failsafe mechanisms activate if landing trajectory deviates.
technical_notes: Integrate sensors for altitude, velocity, and orientation.
Coordinate with navigation system for final approach.

stories.title: Design Spacecraft for Mars Mission
stories.description: As a mission engineer, I want to design a spacecraft capable of traveling to Mars and supporting the mission objectives, so that the mission can be executed successfully.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spacecraft design includes propulsion, life support, communication, and scientific payload systems.
Design meets safety and mission duration requirements for Mars travel.
Design documentation is reviewed and approved by the engineering team.

edge_cases: Design must consider failure modes of critical systems.
Design must accommodate potential weight and size constraints for launch vehicle.
technical_notes: Use CAD and simulation tools for design validation.
Coordinate with propulsion and payload teams for subsystem integration.

Each story includes acceptance criteria, edge cases, technical notes, dependencies, and complexity estimates.
recommendations: Prioritize spacecraft design (STORY-001) as foundational for other stories.
Ensure close coordination between navigation (STORY-003) and landing (STORY-004) teams due to dependency.
Plan for integration testing phases after launch preparation and navigation systems are ready.
